```{r}

#pipe function -  link multiple steps in an analysis.

numbers <- c( 2, 4, 6, 10)

numbers |> sum()

my_result <- numbers |>
  sum() |>
  sqrt() |> #square root
  round()

print(my_result)

#do 3 functions to the number vectors series in order from top down

input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)

results <- input_vec |> 
    mean() |>
    abs() |>
    round () 
print (results)


# compare functions to see certain rows only:

#Operator	Meaning
#==	is equal to
#!=	is not equal to
#>	is greater than
#>=	is greater than or equal to
#<	is less than
#<=	is less than or equal to

y <-7
print(y==7)
print(y<15)
print(y>20)
print(y<=20)

```
